title: Anti-inflammatory activity of caffeic acid derivatives from Ilex rotunda.
authors: Kim, Chang-Kwon; Yu, Jayeon; Le, DucDat; Han, Sanghee; Yu, Soojung; Lee, Mina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究冬青提取物中咖啡酸衍生物的抗炎活性，分子对接仅涉及小分子与iNOS蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Ilex rotunda Thunb. has been used in traditional medicine for treating rheumatoid arthritis, relieving pain and indigestion. In the present study, we isolated three new caffeic acid benzyl ester (CABE) analogs (1-3) along with eight known compounds (4-11) from the extract of I. rotunda. The absolute configuration of alpha-hydoxycarboxylic acid in 1 was assigned with the phenylglycine methyl ester (PGME) method. We further investigated their anti-inflammatory activities in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced macrophages (RAW 264.7) cells. Among them, compounds 2-4, 7, 8, 10, and 11 suppressed the production of nitric oxide (NO), pro-inflammatory mediators. It was additionally confirmed that the anti-inflammatory effect of active compound 2 was through significant suppression of cytokines, including interleukin (IL)-6, IL-1beta, tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha, and IL-8 in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells and colon epithelial (HT-29) cells. Western blot analysis revealed that compound 2 decreased the LPS-induced expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), cyclooxygenase (COX-2), and phosphorylated extracellular regulated kinase (pERK)1/2. The following molecular docking simulations showed the significant interactions of compound 2 with the iNOS protein. These results suggested that the compound 2 can be used as potential candidate for treating inflammatory diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
abstract_zh: 铁冬青（Ilex rotunda Thunb.）在传统医学中用于治疗类风湿性关节炎、缓解疼痛和消化不良。在本研究中，我们从铁冬青提取物中分离出三种新的咖啡酸苄酯（CABE）类似物（1-3）以及八种已知化合物（4-11）。通过苯基甘氨酸甲酯（PGME）方法确定了化合物1中α-羟基羧酸的绝对构型。我们进一步研究了它们在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的巨噬细胞（RAW 264.7）中的抗炎活性。其中，化合物2-4、7、8、10和11抑制了一氧化氮（NO）和促炎介质的产生。此外，还确认了活性化合物2的抗炎作用是通过显著抑制细胞因子，包括白细胞介素（IL）-6、IL-1β、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α和IL-8，在LPS刺激的RAW 264.7细胞和结肠上皮（HT-29）细胞中实现的。Western blot分析显示，化合物2降低了LPS诱导的诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）、环氧合酶（COX-2）和磷酸化细胞外调节激酶（pERK）1/2的表达。随后的分子对接模拟显示了化合物2与iNOS蛋白的显著相互作用。这些结果表明，化合物2可作为治疗炎症性疾病（如炎症性肠病（IBD））的潜在候选药物。
